newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle steady/firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle steady/firm - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers moderately active. Slaughter steers steady to firm; heifers steady. - USDA

Slaughter Steers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 63.00-64.00, part load 64.50, load long-haul 1320 lbs 66.00. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 62.00-63.00. Select 1-2 61.00-62.00. Select and Choice Holsteins 1-2 1300-1500 lbs 56.00-58.50.
Slaughter Heifers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1200 lbs 62.50-63.50. Select and Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 61.50-62.50. Select 1-2 60.50-61.50.
